C1114.title: A Real-World Case Study of Attacking ChatGPT via Lightweight Prompt Injection
C1114.summary: This report presents a real-world case study demonstrating how to attack large language model platforms like ChatGPT through prompt injection. The attacker uses lightweight methods to craft malicious instructions in an attempt to manipulate model behavior.
